description: What the platform said vs what the market did. Standing measured state: unified_score 5d rank IC is ~0.0001 (t=0.02) and no factor tested clears multiple-testing correction — read these panels as diagnostics, not as a trade signal.
title: Signal Accuracy & Movers

panels.title: Directional hit rate on the day's 40 biggest movers
panels.description: Of the top-20 gainers and top-20 losers on the latest session that carried a non-Hold unified_recommendations call, the share where the direction was right. Chance is ~50%. Liquidity floor from the dropdown.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT symbol, date, close, volume,
         lag(close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) AS prev
  FROM stock_ohlcv
  WHERE date >= (SELECT max(date) - 14 FROM stock_ohlcv) AND coalesce(is_suspect, 0) = 0
),
l AS (
  SELECT * FROM w
  WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM w) AND prev > 0
    AND close * volume >= $minturnover * 10000000
),
m AS (
  SELECT l.symbol, 100.0 * (l.close - l.prev) / l.prev AS chg,
         (SELECT classification FROM unified_recommendations r
          WHERE r.symbol = l.symbol ORDER BY r.computed_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS cls
  FROM l
),
top AS (
  (SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY chg DESC LIMIT 20)
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY chg ASC LIMIT 20)
)
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (
         WHERE (cls LIKE '%Buy%' AND chg > 0) OR (cls LIKE '%Sell%' AND chg < 0))
       / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE cls LIKE '%Buy%' OR cls LIKE '%Sell%'), 0), 1) AS "hit rate"
FROM top

panels.title: Sell : Buy ratio (latest ranker run)
panels.description: The platform's standing skew. Measured 2026-08-14 at ~32:1 across the full universe; the neutral-tag scoring bug explained only ~1% of it, so a large residual is unexplained.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification LIKE '%Sell%')::numeric
              / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification LIKE '%Buy%'), 0)), 1) AS "sell:buy"
FROM unified_recommendations
WHERE computed_at = (SELECT max(computed_at) FROM unified_recommendations)

panels.title: Gradable pre-market ranker dates
panels.description: unified_recommendations_history sessions whose FIRST run landed before 03:45 UTC (pre-open). ~30 are needed before a t-stat on ranker accuracy means anything. Anything computed off the live unified_recommendations table alone is grading a post-close re-run against its own day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "pre-market dates" FROM (
  SELECT computed_at FROM unified_recommendations_history
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING bool_or(generated_at::time < time '03:45')
) t
SELECT count(*) AS "WIN + LOSS rows" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE outcome IN ('WIN', 'LOSS')

panels.title: Latest session — top gainers vs the system's call
panels.description: Reverse-engineering pass: real movers first, then what the platform said about them beforehand. A 'Strong Sell / S_ELITE' on a +20% name is the signature this dashboard exists to surface.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT symbol, date, close, volume,
         lag(close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY date) AS prev
  FROM stock_ohlcv
  WHERE date >= (SELECT max(date) - 14 FROM stock_ohlcv) AND coalesce(is_suspect, 0) = 0
),
l AS (
  SELECT * FROM w
  WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM w) AND prev > 0
    AND close * volume >= $minturnover * 10000000
)
SELECT l.symbol AS "Symbol",
       round((100.0 * (l.close - l.prev) / l.prev)::numeric, 2) AS "Change %",
       round((l.close * l.volume / 1e7)::numeric, 1) AS "Turnover (cr)",
       coalesce(u.classification, '(no call)') AS "System call",
       u.conviction_level AS "Conviction",
       round(u.unified_score::numeric, 1) AS "Score",
       u.sector AS "Sector"
FROM l
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT classification, conviction_level, unified_score, sector
  FROM unified_recommendations r WHERE r.symbol = l.symbol
  ORDER BY r.computed_at DESC LIMIT 1
) u ON true
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: ⚠ Win rate by source × label definition × horizon — DO NOT compare rows across label definitions
panels.description: terminal_pct2 (fixed ±2% terminal return) and path_barrier (path-based max favourable excursion) are structurally different rules. Live-measured on the same calendar window they read 41-44% vs 88-91%, and the gap is almost entirely the label, not skill. Compare only within a label definition.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT signal_source AS "Source",
       coalesce(nullif(label_definition, ''), '(unlabelled)') AS "Label definition",
       horizon_days AS "Horizon (d)",
       count(*) AS "Graded",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome IN ('WIN', 'LOSS')) AS "Decisive",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'WIN')
             / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome IN ('WIN', 'LOSS')), 0), 1) AS "Win rate %",
       round(avg(return_pct)::numeric, 3) AS "Avg return %"
FROM signal_outcomes
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

panels.title: Win rate over time, by source (separate label definitions — read each line alone)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d AS "time",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'WIN' AND src = 'technical')
             / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome IN ('WIN','LOSS') AND src = 'technical'), 0), 1)
         AS "technical (path_barrier)",
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'WIN' AND src = 'confluence')
             / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome IN ('WIN','LOSS') AND src = 'confluence'), 0), 1)
         AS "confluence (terminal_pct2)"
FROM (
  SELECT left(signal_date, 10)::date AS d, signal_source AS src, outcome
  FROM signal_outcomes WHERE signal_date ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
) t
WHERE $__timeFilter(d)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ranker output distribution over time
panels.description: unified_recommendations_history. A structural drift in the Buy/Sell/Hold mix that is not matched by a change in the market is a scoring bug, not a market call.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT computed_at::date AS "time",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification LIKE '%Buy%') AS "Buy",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification LIKE '%Sell%') AS "Sell",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE classification = 'Hold') AS "Hold"
FROM unified_recommendations_history
WHERE $__timeFilter(computed_at::date)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Conviction ladder — latest ranker run
panels.description: Strong Sell (S_ELITE) has measured WORSE than plain Sell (A_HIGH) on both graded dates so far — the opposite of what conviction should mean.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(conviction_level, '(none)') || ' · ' || coalesce(classification, '(none)') AS "Bucket",
       count(*) AS "Symbols",
       round(avg(unified_score)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg score"
FROM unified_recommendations
WHERE computed_at = (SELECT max(computed_at) FROM unified_recommendations)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Ranker provenance — is each session gradable?
panels.description: A session is only gradable as a forward signal if its first run landed before the open. Runs stamped after 03:45 UTC are grading a post-close re-run against its own day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT computed_at AS "Session",
       count(DISTINCT generated_at) AS "Runs",
       min(generated_at) AS "First run (UTC)",
       max(generated_at) AS "Last run (UTC)",
       count(DISTINCT symbol) AS "Symbols",
       bool_or(generated_at::time < time '03:45') AS "Pre-market?"
FROM unified_recommendations_history
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC
LIMIT 60

panels.title: Trade geometry — excursion stats by horizon
panels.description: signal_excursions. 'MFE before MAE %' is the share of signals that reached their best point before their worst — below 50% means the stop is hit first more often than not, which destroys a real gross edge regardless of the terminal return.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT horizon_days AS "Horizon (d)",
       count(*) AS "Signals",
       round(avg(mfe_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg MFE %",
       round(avg(mae_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg MAE %",
       round(avg(horizon_close_pct)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg terminal %",
       round(avg(days_to_mfe)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg days to MFE",
       round((100.0 * avg(mfe_before_mae))::numeric, 1) AS "MFE before MAE %"
FROM signal_excursions
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
